_comment: The shipped configuration leaves it off, so the default result stays identical to v1 and the
regression baseline keeps its meaning. Use it as an override:
Measured on the real station at 2026-10-20 (auto face, no tracker pose):
upper face 99.74% at 114 points (poses: 99.70% at 102), lower face 97.46% at 134 (poses: 97.06% at 155),
plan runtime 772 s against 293 s - 2.63x, inside the 3x budget the design allows.
Read that as: coverage holds or improves and the path is now scanned, not flown over; the
corner count does NOT drop, because a constant pose only stays valid along a few hundred
millimetres of a curved panel. See the design document, section 13.
NOTE, 2026-10-20 (point-count work): those 114 points were measured with the selection
running to coverage exhaustion. The shipped configuration now stops at
target.coverage_target_pct (99.0) and prices candidates in corners rather than millimetres,
so this override alone no longer reproduces 114 points - use configs/legacy_exhaust.json
for that. Also note that of those 114 points the delivered strokes actually swept 91.98%,
because selected single poses were counted in the coverage figure but never handed to the
path; that defect is fixed, so from now on the reported percentage and the program agree.
